modalities.evidence: EEG data were recorded using a BrainAmp amplifier

output.population: Forty-one right-handed Japanese native speakers (22 females, 19 males; mean age 20.5, SD 2.89) with no neurological illness and normal or corrected-to-normal vision
output.summary: EEG recorded from Japanese native speakers reading newspaper articles presented word by word, using a 64-channel cap. Part of the BCCWJ-Brain collection alongside separate fMRI and MEG datasets using the same stimuli.
